The problem was duplication. Every remote entry embedded its own copy of `@module-federation/runtime-core`, about 50 kB of the roughly 85 kB raw entry, so a page downloaded the identical runtime once per app. The fix, PR #1853 (merge commit `04f538d`, ticket O3-5873), makes the app shell publish the runtime on a global and has remotes read it from there.

**Why it was a problem**
- The runtime is identical across modules, so every module's entry repeated it. The changeset says a page now downloads it once rather than once per app. A production remote entry for `@openmrs/esm-login-app` dropped from about 85 kB to about 32 kB raw (about 26 kB to 9.7 kB gzipped). About 14 kB of runtime stays per remote.
- The PR also notes that the runtime is the "overhead" in each app's initial chunk.

**What the app shell does now**
- `publishFederationRuntime()` in `federation-runtime.ts` sets `_OPENMRS_FEDERATION_SDK` and `_OPENMRS_FEDERATION_ERROR_CODES` on `globalThis`. It also logs an error if `_FEDERATION_RUNTIME_CORE` is missing, which means the shell was built without `experiments.provideExternalRuntime`. That global is the shared `runtime-core` that the shell provides.
- The shell's `initializeSpa` calls into the shared share scope and pins the framework to the shell's copy (`index.ts`).
- The remote-side rspack config sets `experiments.externalRuntime: true`, so remotes read `runtime-core` from the global. It also maps `@module-federation/sdk` and `@module-federation/error-codes` to those globals with an `ExternalsPlugin`. `@module-federation/runtime` and `webpack-bundler-runtime` stay bundled per remote because they cache a federation instance at module scope; sharing them caused RUNTIME-010.

**Caveats**
- The change is breaking. Remotes built with this version need an app shell of this version or newer, and they refuse to start under an older shell. Older apps still work under the new shell.
- The webpack config got the same treatment. I did not read `packages/tooling/webpack-config/src/index.ts` or the shell's `rspack.config.js`; I only confirmed from the PR's file list that they changed.

Every remote entry embedded its own copy of `@module-federation/runtime-core`, about 50 kB of the roughly 85 kB raw entry, so a page downloaded the identical runtime once per app. The fix, PR #1853 (merge commit `04f538d`, ticket O3-5873), makes the app shell publish the runtime on a global and has remotes read it from there.

**Why it was a problem**
- The runtime is identical across modules, so every module's entry repeated it. The changeset says a page now downloads it once rather than once per app. A production remote entry for `@openmrs/esm-login-app` dropped from about 85 kB to about 32 kB raw (about 26 kB to 9.7 kB gzipped). About 14 kB of runtime stays per remote.
- The PR also notes that the runtime is the "overhead" in each app's initial chunk.

**What the app shell does now**
- `publishFederationRuntime()` in `federation-runtime.ts` sets `_OPENMRS_FEDERATION_SDK` and `_OPENMRS_FEDERATION_ERROR_CODES` on `globalThis`. It also logs an error if `_FEDERATION_RUNTIME_CORE` is missing, which means the shell was built without `experiments.provideExternalRuntime`. That global is the shared `runtime-core` that the shell provides.
- The shell's `initializeSpa` calls into the shared share scope and pins the framework to the shell's copy (`index.ts`).
- The remote-side rspack config sets `experiments.externalRuntime: true`, so remotes read `runtime-core` from the global. It also maps `@module-federation/sdk` and `@module-federation/error-codes` to those globals with an `ExternalsPlugin`. `@module-federation/runtime` and `webpack-bundler-runtime` stay bundled per remote because they cache a federation instance at module scope; sharing them caused RUNTIME-010.

**Caveats**
- The change is breaking. Remotes built with this version need an app shell of this version or newer, and they refuse to start under an older shell. Older apps still work under the new shell.
- The webpack config got the same treatment. I did not read `packages/tooling/webpack-config/src/index.ts` or the shell's `rspack.config.js`; I only confirmed from the PR's file list that they changed.

**Why it was a problem**
- The runtime is identical across modules, so every module's entry repeated it. **What the app shell does now**
- `publishFederationRuntime()` in `federation-runtime.ts` sets `_OPENMRS_FEDERATION_SDK` and `_OPENMRS_FEDERATION_ERROR_CODES` on `globalThis`. - The shell's `initializeSpa` calls into the shared share scope and pins the framework to the shell's copy (`index.ts`).
